# Fixture policy

Positive full data is generated by `tests/synthetic/generate.py` and committed once under `examples/synthetic_asset/neutral.json`. This avoids duplicated large payloads.

Negative fixtures are constructed in memory by unit tests: cycles, bad weights, missing tracks, unsupported semantics, incorrect identities, non-finite values, unknown fields, non-reproducible data and suspect publication content. They contain no real credentials, private paths, binary assets or proprietary source.

New fixtures must be original/synthetic or have explicitly reviewed publication rights. Do not include game files, extracted animation dumps or large serialized decoder output. The publication guard is intentionally stricter than `.gitignore`.
